# Packages
```{r}
install.packages("dplyr")
library(dplyr)
```

# Data
```{r}
# read data
getwd()
df <- read.csv("context_only_data.csv")
head(df)
```
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(ID = paste0("context_", row_number()))

df <- df %>%
  select(ID, Context)
```


```{r}
# Save the new csv-file ready for prompting
write.csv(df, "context_ID.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
longest <- max(nchar(df$Context)))
print(nchar(longest$Context))


```
